value.rationale: The source specifically suggests curvature-preconditioner reuse for constant-Hessian objectives. The complete sharp instability interval for an interpolating quadratic with condition-one full Hessian isolates a source-relevant design tradeoff: retaining a randomly learned step produces an unstable environment mixture even where independently refreshed curvature gives geometric mean-square contraction. The two schemes share identical one-step second moments, but differ at every later nontrivial horizon. The cutoff and rational witness are exact, mathematically motivated, and potentially informative for update-frequency selection, without claiming broader implementation failure.
